Faerin Lothar ( ) is a Lamplighter of the Hallowfall Arathi. A member of the noble Lothar family, she stowed away on the Hallowfall Expedition as a child. She lost her left arm and eye in the process, but has since learned to fight with a prosthetic shield. She seeks allies willing to venture into the shadows and teach her people it is something to be faced, not feared.
